definition.name: Seascapes
definition.description: Calm seas, beaches, harbours and boats in clear light, from Dutch painters to the Impressionists, chosen to bring the coast quietly into a family room.

works.alt_text: Tall sailing ships rest on a glassy harbour at sunrise, with a rowing boat in front and the city faint in a peach-coloured haze.

placard.title: Harbor of Boston, with the City in the Distance
placard.creator: Fitz Henry Lane (American, 1804–1865)
placard.dimensions: Framed: 66 x 104.8 x 14 cm (26 x 41 1/4 x 5 1/2 in.); Unframed: 43.2 x 68.6 cm (17 x 27 in.)

works.alt_text: Fishing boats with red-brown sails head out over a turquoise sea while people gather on a beach among dark thatched boat sheds.

placard.title: The Departure of the Boats, Étretat
placard.creator: Claude Monet (French, 1840–1926)

works.alt_text: Dark sailing boats and a small steamer trailing smoke cross a calm turquoise sea under a pale sky.

placard.title: Sea View, Calm Weather (Vue de mer, temps calme)
placard.creator: Édouard Manet (French, 1832–1883)

works.alt_text: A pebble beach curves toward a distant town, with blue and brown rowing boats, a few fishermen and sailing boats on a pale green sea.
Tall-masted ships and barges lie along a quay on still water that reflects them, under a light, cloudy sky.

placard.title: View of Bordeaux, from the Quai des Chartrons
placard.creator: Eugène Boudin (French, 1824–1898)

works.alt_text: Fishing boats wait on a flat, silvery sea under a big grey cloudy sky, with men wading near a wooden jetty on the left.
A three-masted ship flying a French flag sails into a harbour past a line of white houses and green hills under a bright, cloudy sky.

placard.title: Entrance to the Port of Honfleur
placard.creator: Johan Barthold Jongkind (Dutch, 1819-1891)

works.alt_text: A wide, quiet grey sea with low sand bars and a single small sail on the horizon, painted in soft, pale strokes.
Four small white sailing boats drift on a still, grey-green sea that meets a pale sky in a soft horizon.

placard.title: Trouville (Grey and Green, the Silver Sea)
placard.creator: James McNeill Whistler (American, 1834–1903)

works.alt_text: Golden cliffs and rocky islets rise from a calm, hazy sea at sunset, with a small sailing boat near the shore.
Ladies with parasols in full skirts, children, a donkey and a dog gather on a beach under a broad grey-blue sky.
A watercolour of a calm blue-grey sea meeting a band of white light below grey clouds, with dark rocks in the lower left.

placard.title: Prout's Neck, Evening
placard.creator: Winslow Homer (American, 1836-1910)
placard.medium: Watercolor, with rewetting and blotting, over traces of graphite, on thick, rough-textured, ivory wove paper (top edge trimmed)

works.alt_text: A broad sandy beach at low tide with pools of blue water, a beached sailing boat and tiny walkers under a clear blue sky.

placard.title: Beach at Low Tide (Mouth of the River)
placard.creator: Edgar Degas (French, 1834–1917)
placard.medium: Pastel on light brown wove paper

works.alt_text: Fishermen unload a boat on a rocky shore beside a ruined round tower, with tall ships in a misty harbour behind.
A calm, pale bay with small boats moored in rows and a long low waterfront of masts and buildings across the water.
Wooden boats lie on a sandy boatyard among planks and scaffolding, with a sailing ship on the water beyond.
Children and women in bathing dresses splash in green, white-capped surf while a girl in a red cap sits on the sand.
Steep reddish cliffs drop into a calm grey-blue bay, seen from a stone terrace with a few trees and white houses.
Groups of people in colourful dresses picnic and stroll under leafy trees beside a pale blue bay with sailing boats.
Fishermen cast lines from rocks in a hazy morning harbour, with a round stone tower on the left and a tall ship in the soft light.
The white domed church of Santa Maria della Salute stands across a sunny Venetian canal busy with gondolas and strolling figures.

placard.title: The Church of Santa Maria della Salute, Venice
placard.creator: Michele Marieschi (Italian, 1710–1743)

works.alt_text: A watercolour of a harbour entrance guarded by a pale stone lighthouse and fort, with ships at anchor and a small boat crossing in front.

placard.title: The Entrance to the Harbor of Marseilles
placard.creator: William Callow (English, 1812-1908)
placard.medium: Watercolor with touches of gouache, over traces of graphite, and scraping, on off-white wove paper

works.alt_text: A deep blue sea under a violet-blue sky full of small white clouds, with a few white wave crests.
A golden sunset glows in bands of orange and grey over a wide wet beach, with a few small figures and distant ships.
